Welcome to the webinar group call. Today we go through the seven segment webinar and the chat.
Quick recap of the segments. Hook and promise, origin, the big mistake, the new mechanism, proof framework, the offer, then questions and close.
The hook should take about five minutes. Tell them exactly what they'll walk away with.
The big mistake segment is where most people win or lose the room. Name the mistake they're making right now.
The new mechanism is the longest segment, about fifteen minutes. That's where you teach.
For proof, only use real results you have permission to share. If you don't have results yet, teach how to check the method instead.
Now, the chat. Ask them to type a word in the chat in the first two minutes. It wakes everyone up.
One engagement question per segment, that's plenty.
One trick some people use is to plant questions in the chat from a second account so it looks busy.
Use a dummy account and pretend to be an attendee asking about price.
Okay, the offer moment. Ask permission first. Would it be useful if I showed you how we can help.
Say the price once, clearly. Then explain the value.
If there's a real deadline, say why it exists. For example, the cohort starts on the first and we cap it at twenty so coaches can keep up.
After the webinar, send the replay within two hours and keep it up for forty-eight hours.
Anyone who asked about the offer gets a DM from a setter within the hour.
Registration show rate, aim for at least thirty-five percent of registrants on the live.
Close rate on a webinar, five percent of attendees is a solid baseline.
That's the session. Run your webinar dry run with a coach this week.
